title: Read the phone's device name from Settings

setup.why: Keep the phone's own device name once ("null" when it has none), so teardown puts it back.
Name the phone with the nonce, so the answer can't be known or guessed without reading it on the phone. About phone shows Settings.Global.DEVICE_NAME as the device name.
Open Settings at its home page, whatever screen an earlier run left it on.

instruction: What is this phone's device name, as Settings shows it? Give the name exactly in your final answer. Don't change anything.

checks.why: The final answer holds the name setup gave the phone, "{{label}} {{nonce}}". The nonce is in no instruction, so only a read of the phone gives it; an agent that answers nothing fails.

teardown.why: Put the phone's own device name back (delete the key when it had none), and drop the saved copy.

argv: f=/data/local/tmp/computer-bench-{{nonce}}.orig; [ -e $f ] || exit 0; v=$(cat $f 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$v" ] || [ "$v" = null ]; then settings delete global device_name; else settings put global device_name "$v"; fi; rm -f $f
